definitions.name: Regime 1
definitions.description: Low-noise, near-stationary dynamics (A = 0.95 I, Q = 0.001 I)

definitions.name: Regime 2
definitions.description: High-gain, high-noise dynamics (A = 1.5 I, Q = 0.5 I)

notes: attack_probability is a model output, not a verified classification.
Rows are treated as one ordered sequence; the regime filter starts from a fresh state at row 1.
The row index is the flow identifier: the supported schemas contain no flow ID.
Regimes are neutral filter states with hand-set dynamics; they are not attack families.
warnings: The models were trained on a 1-in-k subsampled, time-ordered stream; dense captures may behave differently.
